mechanism_narrative: The sustained and accelerating decline in retail and recreation mobility over the past four weeks indicates a deepening trend of reduced non-essential activity, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks as public caution persists.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, indicating a reversal of the observed trend.

mechanism_narrative: A continued sharp decline in workplace attendance, as observed in the last week (t-1w to t-0w), signifies a further reduction in daily commutes and associated retail visits, pushing RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decrease over the next 14 days despite WORKPLACES falling by more than 10 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of increasing time spent at home (RESIDENTIAL) and decreasing use of public transport (TRANSIT) indicates a strong public adherence to stay-at-home orders, which will suppress RETAIL_REC further over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL increasing and TRANSIT decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: If current lockdown measures are slightly eased, the recent slight recovery in PARKS mobility (t-1w to t-0w) could be an early indicator of people venturing out more, potentially leading to a small uplift in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases week-on-week by more than 5 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days does not increase, even if PARKS mobility continues to rise.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent decline in grocery and pharmacy visits suggests a reduction in even essential outings, reflecting heightened caution and reduced overall mobility, which will negatively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite GROCERY_PHARM continuing to decline.

mechanism_narrative: If the increase in residential mobility plateaus or begins to decline, it would signal a shift in public behavior towards less strict adherence to stay-at-home, potentially allowing a slight recovery in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls week-on-week or increases by less than 1 point
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not increase, even if RESIDENTIAL mobility plateaus or declines.

mechanism_narrative: The combined sharp and sustained declines in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicate a severe reduction in economic activity and daily commuting, which will continue to depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining at current low levels or declining further.

mechanism_narrative: A continued tightening of government restrictions, reflected in further declines across RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT, will inevitably lead to a further decrease in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as non-essential movement is curtailed.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT all decline week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite all specified mobility categories declining week-on-week.
